_comment: Pilot 3: LoRA rank sweep at 1.5B, reusing pilot2's data, evals and full-FT result (same out_dir, so those steps are skipped). Motivation: Nief et al. 2026 (arXiv:2606.00831) report subliminal learning disappears with full fine-tuning and shows an inverted-U in LoRA rank. LoRA settings follow the Zurich reproduction (arXiv:2609.12586): alpha = rank, lr 2e-4, 3 epochs.

methods.name: lora_r256
methods._note: control rerun with batch 8 x 8 + grad checkpointing to stop GPU memory spilling into shared RAM (treatment ran 16 x 4 without it and took 5.2 h). Same effective batch of 64 and same 471 steps.
